content: Welcome! How may I help you?

Here are some cake options:

1. **2D CAKES**: 2D image imposed on top with any choice of cake. 2D Cartoon Drawing - RS 150/- (Per Kg) plus the cost of the selected cake (Min 2 kg). Vanilla/Black Forest/White Forest (2Kg + 2D Charges) RS 1798/-. ![Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-01-06_124712.png)

2. **JELLY BLACK FOREST**: Chocolate sponge cake soaked in sugar syrup, sandwiched with fresh cream chocolate, cherries & choco chip, topped with strawberry jello (Min 1 Kg). Price: RS 899/-. ![Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-01-06_123854.png)

3. **RAINBOW CAKE**: Vanilla sponge cake soaked in sugar syrup, sandwiched with fresh cream vanilla layered with food colors & topped with rainbow sprinkles (Min 1Kg). Making Time: 24 hrs. Price: RS 1299/-. ![Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-01-06_123929.png)

4. **HAZELNUT CHOCOLATE**: Chocolate sponge cake soaked in sugar syrup, sandwiched & topped with fresh cream chocolate, hazelnut choco spread & melted chocolate (Min 1Kg). Price: RS 1099/-. ![Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-01-06_124038.png)

Here are some wedding cake options:

1. **WEDDING CAKES**: Two Step Dummy - Rs 3500/- plus the cost of the selected cake (Min-2 Kg). Any model of your choice can be made after discussion with our customer care executive. ![Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-01-06_125406.png)

2. **3D & HEART SHAPE CAKES**: 3D shape on top with any choice of cake. 3D Cartoon Shapes - RS 250/- (Per Kg) plus the cost of the selected cake (Min 2 kg). Heart Shapes - RS 150/- (Per Kg) plus the cost of the selected cake. Vanilla/Black Forest/White Forest (2Kg + 3D Charges) RS 1998/-. ![Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-01-06_125108.png)

3. **BARBIE DOLL CAKES**: Dream princess doll cake for every little girl, vanilla sponge cake soaked with sugar syrup, sandwiched & topped with vanilla butter/fresh cream (Min 2 kg). ![Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-01-06_124902.png)
You're welcome! If you have any more questions or need assistance, feel free to ask.

Here are the details for the Black Forest cake:

**BLACK FOREST**: Premium Dark Chocolate Sponge soaked in flavoured special sugar syrup, sandwiched & topped with Vanilla Fresh Cream & Red Cherries, decorated with Premium Dark chocolate shavings. 

**Price**: RS 740/-. ![Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-01-06_113937.png)
